They can now refocus on patients, ensure orders go through, and close care gaps."– Aidan Anderson, Director of Operations at Nimbus HealthOnboarding with Tandem1Get a demo of TandemSchedule a brief introductory meeting with Tandem for a demo and Q&A.2Create your accountSign up through our website to get access to the platform and add your team.3Start using TandemTandem makes setup easy so you can start automating prescriptions immediately.How Tandem worksSend prescription to TandemPrescribe through your EHR, just like normal.If you set up EHR integration, Tandem will automatically pull patient records. Otherwise, you'll upload the records to the portal.Prior authorizationTandem completes the prior authorization form within 24 hours of receiving the prescription.After the provider approves the completed PA in the portal, Tandem will submit it to the payer and conduct follow-ups for status updates.PA denials and appealsIf a PA is denied, Tandem uploads the denial letter and provides next steps for you to choose from.If you choose to initiate an appeal, Tandem generates an appeal letter for review and then submits it to the payer.Program enrollmentsTandem facilitates enrollment for patient support programs (e.g., hub, bridge, PAP) based on drug and patient eligibility.Tandem pre-populates forms and collects electronic signatures from the provider and patient, as needed.Pharmacy navigationTandem identifies the appropriate pharmacy for each prescription based on payer network requirements and patient preference.Prescriptions are then sent to the pharmacy for dispensing.Patient communicationTandem keeps patients in the loop with real-time updates until their prescription is ready to fill.FAQsWhich types of practice does Tandem work best for?Tandem supports thousands of providers across multiple specialties. These range from independent practices with 1-2 providers to large physician groups with hundreds of locations.What does Tandem cost? Does it support all types of medications?Tandem is free for providers and patients. We support any drug, any insurance, and any pharmacy, without restrictions.How does Tandem protect patient data?Tandem's platform is fully HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2 Type 2 certified, with enterprise-grade security. All PHI is protected under BAA.Can Tandem integrate with the EHR?Tandem can be used with or without EHR integration. If setting up EHR access requires too many steps, you can get started without integration without any setup—all you have to do is upload records when required.Does Tandem support practices that don't e-prescribe?At this time, Tandem only supports electronic prescriptions (eRx) sent through the EHR.Get Tandem for your practiceSee how Tandem can eliminate your paperwork and get patients on therapy faster.Create accountAboutCareersPrivacyTrusted by practices nationwideBook a Demo© 2025 Tandem Technology, Inc.
